d: Lounge in Violetta's house. In the bottom is the door that puts to another room; there are two other side rooms; on the left, a fireplace with a mirror on top. In the middle is a richly imbued table. Violetta, sitting on a sofa, is talking with the Doctor and with some Friends, while others go to meet those who come, among which are the Baron and Flora to the Marquis' arm.
Those said, the Viscount Gastone de Letorières, Alfredo Germont; Affecned servants around the canteen.
Violetta, Alfredo, and Gastone on time.
Violetta, and everyone else coming back from the hall heated by dances.
Violet alone.

Country house near Paris. Ground living room. In the bottom in front of the viewers, is a fireplace, above which a mirror and a clock, between two doors closed by crystals that put to a garden. On the first floor, two other doors, one in front of the other. Chairs, tables, some books, the necessities to write. Alfred enters into hunting costume.
Said and Annina in travel tools.
Alfredo alone.
Violetta enters with some cards, talking to Annina, then Joseph in time.
Violetta, then Mr Germont, introduced by Giuseppe who advanced two chairs, starts again.
Violetta, then Annina, then Alfredo.
Alfredo, then Giuseppe, then a time Commissionary.
Alfredo, put Mr. Germont in the garden.

Gallery in the palace of Flora, richly decorated and illuminated. A door in the bottom and two side. To the right below, a table, with what you need for the game; to the left, rich table with flowers and refreshments, various chairs and a sofa. Flora, the Marquis, the Doctor and others Invited enter from the left talking among them.
Said, and many ladies disguised as Zingare, entering from the right.
Dettali, Gastone and other friends disguised as Mattadori, Spagnoli Piccadori, who enter strongly from the right.
Said and Alfredo, then Violetta with the Baron. A Servant in time.
Violetta who returns to drown, then Alfredo.
Said, and all the precedents that confusedly come back.
Said, and Mr. Germont entering the last words.

Bedroom of Violetta. In the bottom is a bed with half-tired curtains; a window closed by internal taxes; at the bed a stool on which a bottle of water, a cup of crystal, several medicines. Halfway through the scene a toilet, near a canapé; more distant another piece of furniture, on which burns a nightlight, various chairs and other furniture. The door is on the left; in front there is a fireplace with fire on. Violetta sleeps on the bed. Annina, sitting at the fireplace, is also asleep.
Told and the Doctor.
Violetta and Annina.
Violetta, alone.
Detta and Annina, who returns hasty.
Violetta, Alfredo and Annina.
Say, Annina, Mr. Germont and the Doctor.
